notes.title: Update v1.25.10.01
notes.content:
New
You can now change the screen resolution in the in-game settings.
You can now toggle fullscreen/windowed mode.
Added an Exit Game button to the Main Menu.
User's settings (such as volume and resolutions) are now saved across sessions.

Bug fixes
Tutorial bugs that prevent players from continuing.

MISC
Corrected spelling mistakes in the "Form a War Party" description.
Corrected spelling mistakes in the "Thule" description.
Corrected spelling mistakes in the "Trophy" description.
